description: A 4x4 matrix keypad: 4 row pins and 4 column pins, scanned in software to detect which key is pressed.
how_to_use: R1-R4 (rows) and C1-C4 (columns) are all ordinary digital I/O pins, matrix-scanned by the sketch — not interchangeable with each other (which row/column a pin is wired to determines which key maps where), and not a shared bus.

plain.what: A flat keypad with 16 buttons (0–9, A–D, * and #) — for passwords and menus.
plain.how: Its 8 wires go to 8 Arduino pins. The Keypad library tells you which key is pressed.
